author: Zintenka
body:
Introducing! My first map submission in Avicore!

I am proud to introduce...

[DTM] DarkTrot



Features:
Villager trading system with gold ingot as currency (First one of Avicore to do dis :D).
Command Block teleporter and xp giver. 
Mob spawner in center: 


50vs50
5 monuments.

Authors:
Zintenka

Imgur: Here

Valid YAML: Here

New Download: Here

I hope you like it!

If not, please specify a clear reason why you don't like it and i'll see what i can do.
